name: wardrobe-diary-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the public Wardrobe Diary data (ROADMAP R-29)

scripts.evals: npm run build --silent && esbuild evals/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=dist/evals.mjs --log-level=warning && node dist/evals.mjs
scripts.build:function: esbuild src/function.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:firebase-functions --external:firebase-admin --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=../functions/lib/index.js
